title: A deliberate wait, one failed evaluation, and no new fills

A deliberate wait, one failed evaluation, and no new fills

Paper trading · 2026-10-16T17:00:28.036981-04:00

This report covers 2026-10-16 from 04:00Z through the 21:00:28Z cutoff (midnight to 5:00 p.m. EDT). The paper decision and the completed mean-reversion book decision recorded no trade proposals, approvals, rejections, or fills. The paper decision considered a possible small MU entry; the book chose a deliberate wait while keeping its existing MU holding. The mean-reversion-adversary evaluation failed, so it has no completed decision. No broker fill report is included in the supplied records. The MU holding belongs to the simulated mean-reversion book, and its observed price is a snapshot from 20:00Z (4:00 p.m. EDT), not a live price. The paper performance snapshot was earlier, at 19:15:13Z, and predates the day’s decisions.

Today's lesson: Thoughts, proposals, and fills are different

A considered trade is not the same as a proposed or filled trade. For example, the paper decision discussed evaluating a $25–$100 MU entry, but its proposal list was empty. The mean-reversion book likewise recorded zero proposals and zero fills. So today’s records show no new trade from either completed decision.

Portfolio review

Paper account

Paper account: the 9:15:13Z performance snapshot reports $2,000 cash and equity, with $0 P&L and 0% return. A later account snapshot at 21:00:27Z also reports $2,000 cash and equity. The paper decision considered whether a $25–$100 MU entry was worth evaluating, but recorded no proposal; therefore no deterministic risk approval or rejection is recorded. No paper fill is reported. The decision describes the account as having no positions or open orders. The paper performance snapshot came before the day's decision, so it does not by itself establish performance after that decision.

mean-reversion

The mean-reversion book began with $2,000 and had $1,950.00684292 cash at the cutoff. Its cutoff marked equity was $1,997.24470620, including the MU holding valued from the 20:00Z observed midpoint. That is $2.75529380 below starting cash, or about 0.138% by subtraction; the book reports realized P&L of $0. The separate 19:19:28Z performance record reports P&L of -$1.92710993 and return of -0.096406%. Those are earlier recorded figures, not the later cutoff mark. Today’s completed book decision was NO_ACTION with a deliberate wait: zero proposals, approvals, rejections, and fills. It cited uncertainty about whether MU’s exceptionally high profitability would persist. The strongest recorded counterargument was that recent results, cash generation, and a lower price could make a small addition attractive if earnings prove durable. A separate SPY buy/hold reference failed because its quote postdated the valuation cutoff; that was a failed reference, not an order or a completed trading decision.

mean-reversion-adversary

The mean-reversion-adversary book reports $2,000 cash and $2,000 equity at the cutoff, with no holding shown. Its evaluation failed during the research-compaction step, so there is no completed decision to describe: the failure is not a deliberate wait. No proposal, risk approval or rejection, or fill is reported for it today. The supplied context has no current-day performance record for this book; its earlier October 13 record showed $2,000 equity and 0% return. Its strongest counterargument or investment reasoning is unknown because the evaluation did not complete.

Every holding

MU — mean-reversion

The mean-reversion book holds 0.053191 MU shares. The recorded average purchase price is $939.88 per share, excluding fees. The supplied observed bid/ask midpoint was $888.08 at 2026-10-16 20:00:00Z (4:00 p.m. EDT); the holding was valued at $47.2379, with an unrealized loss of $2.7553, excluding fees. Although current_price is null, the separate observed_price and valuation are supplied. The recorded reasoning says MU was the book’s strongest candidate, citing recent results and cash generation, but describes its unusually high margins and the risk that earnings could normalize as reasons the downside case remained uncertain. The strongest recorded counterargument to waiting is that those results and the lower entry price could reflect durable earnings strength, and waiting could miss appreciation. No new purchase was proposed for this book today, and no fill was recorded today. No separate current thesis or invalidation checklist is supplied; the decision says the original proposal rationale is truncated.

Read each snapshot at its recorded time

The mean-reversion book’s cutoff mark is $1,997.24470620, while its separate 19:19:28Z performance record reports a -$1.92710993 P&L and -0.096406% return. These are recorded at different times and should be kept distinct. The holding’s later observed midpoint is $888.08, giving a supplied market value of $47.23786328 and unrealized loss of $2.75529380, excluding fees. These snapshots describe the recorded book valuation, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.

What to watch next

Watch for MU’s next quarterly results, which the completed book decision names as its checkpoint for assessing earnings durability. Also note whether the mean-reversion-adversary evaluation completes; today’s failure provides no investment decision.

Observed midpoint: A midpoint calculated from the recorded bid and ask. Here, the supplied observed price is $888.08; it is a snapshot mark, not a guaranteed live or closing price.

Unrealized gain or loss: The gain or loss on a holding that has not been sold, measured against its recorded purchase basis. The book’s figure excludes fees.

Downside case: A result that depends on the source record. Here, the wait decision cited the possibility that unusually high profits could normalize.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
